(VT) vault: a video of a gymnastics vault: the gymnast sprints down the runway, punches the springboard, and flies over the vaulting table to a stuck landing
The gymnast sprints down the runway toward the vaulting table, arms driving quickly as she builds maximum speed.
She hurdles into a round-off, hands striking the runway in turn as her legs snap together onto the springboard.
Facing away from the table, she rebounds off the springboard into a flic-flac, arms reaching back overhead for the table.
Her hands contact the vaulting table as her body passes through a brief handstand, legs whipping over in an arch.
She blocks hard through her shoulders, repulsing off the table and rising into post-flight with her body fully stretched.
She performs a stretched salto backward off the table, hips open, legs pressed together and toes pointed, with no twisting.
During the forward salto she adds a half twist, arms drawing briefly toward her chest as her body turns.
Finishing the final twist late in flight, she opens her arms wide to slow the rotation and spots the mat.
Her stretched body descends toward the landing mat, chest lifting as her feet reach down for the surface.
She lands on both feet facing away from the table, knees bending to cushion the impact, arms reaching forward for balance.
(FX) leap, jump or hop: a video of a leap, jump or hop element on floor exercise: the gymnast springs from the floor into a split, straddle or ring shape and lands back on her feet
The gymnast takes a few running steps across the floor exercise mat, arms swinging to prepare for the takeoff.
She steps into a small chassé, the front leg brushing forward as her arms lift to shoulder height.
She pushes off one foot, kicking her lead leg straight forward and upward into a split leap.
Her legs open into a 180 degree cross split as she rises, and she begins turning quickly.
Her legs pass each other and open into a full cross split in the air, both legs straight.
She completes the 360 degree turn in the air, her legs closing back together beneath her.
Her legs snap back together as she begins to descend toward the mat.
She descends as the rotation finishes, her legs drawing in from the wide straddle line.
She lands on both feet, knees bending to absorb the impact of the turning jump.
She recovers to an upright finish, arms flowing down into a graceful ending line.
(FX) turn: a video of a turn element on floor exercise: the gymnast rises onto one leg and pirouettes her whole body around the vertical axis
The gymnast prepares on the floor exercise mat, stepping into a lunge with arms opened wide to the sides.
She pliés on her front leg, arms sweeping in together as she gathers momentum for the turn.
She pushes up onto relevé, rising high onto the ball of one foot as the turn begins.
Her free leg settles into a low position, toes held near her support ankle, below horizontal.
She rotates on the ball of her foot, hips and shoulders turning as one aligned column.
The second rotation continues, the free leg held unwavering at horizontal throughout the turn.
She completes one full turn, the heel of the free leg still forward at horizontal.
She releases the raised leg and opens her arms as the spin comes to its end.
She rises from the deep squat with control, the free leg lowering to the mat.
She finishes in a stretched stance on the floor, arms held in an elegant closing line.
(FX) salto forward: a video of a forward salto on floor exercise: the gymnast punches from the floor and somersaults forward in the air before landing
The gymnast runs and hurdles into a round-off on the floor, hands striking the mat in turn.
She hurdles off one foot, arms reaching overhead, and brings both feet together in front to punch.
She kicks her back leg powerfully up and over while driving off the front leg, hands never touching.
She drives into a stretched salto forward, body long, then immediately pulls her arms in to twist.
Her arms wrap tightly across her chest, spinning her straight body around its long axis.
She completes one and a half twists during the forward salto, body straight and toes pointed.
Coming over the top of the rotation, she spots the floor and holds the extended line.
Her chest rises as she spots the landing, arms coming forward to control the final rotation.
She lands on both feet facing the direction of travel, knees bending deeply to absorb the impact.
She finishes standing tall on the floor, arms extended in a graceful line overhead.
(FX) salto backward: a video of a backward salto on floor exercise: after a round-off and flic-flac the gymnast somersaults backward in the air before landing
The gymnast runs across the floor exercise mat and hurdles into a powerful round-off, hands striking the mat in turn.
Her feet snap down together from the round-off and she rebounds immediately backward into a flic-flac.
In the flic-flac her hands touch the mat briefly, body arching over as her feet drive down for the punch.
She punches off both feet, arms swinging upward as she sets the backward salto with maximum height.
Her body extends into a stretched salto backward as her arms wrap instantly across her chest.
She completes the first full twist during the first tucked salto, spinning on two axes at once.
She finishes the second salto backward in the tuck, knees pressed tightly to her chest.
She kicks out of the tuck as the second salto completes, legs extending toward the mat.
Her chest rises and her arms come forward as her feet reach down for the mat.
She lands on both feet, knees bending deeply to absorb the impact, arms extending forward for balance.
(BB) leap, jump or hop: a video of a leap, jump or hop element on the balance beam: the gymnast springs from the beam into a split or straddle shape and lands back on the beam
The gymnast stands on the balance beam, feet together, arms lifting as she prepares for the jump.
She bends her knees and swings her arms downward, loading a two-foot takeoff on the narrow beam.
She springs straight upward from both feet, body rising above the beam with arms driving overhead.
Her straight legs lift wide apart into a straddle pike, reaching out toward her extended hands.
Her head and upper back release backward, the rear foot rising toward her head to close the ring.
She completes the half turn so that she now faces back along the beam.
Her eyes stay fixed on the narrow surface as the landing foot closes on the beam.
She lands on one foot on the beam, knee bending softly while the back leg stays extended.
The free leg lowers with control as she secures her balance on the supporting leg.

(BB) turn: a video of a turn element on the balance beam: the gymnast rises onto one leg on the beam and pirouettes around the vertical axis
The gymnast steps into a small lunge on the beam, arms opened wide to prepare the turn.

The free leg lifts to a low position, held below horizontal near the supporting leg.

The free leg stays extended forward at horizontal as her body spins smoothly around.
She drives directly into a second complete rotation without lowering her supporting heel.
The single full turn completes as her shoulders square back to the beam line.
As the second turn finishes, her arms open outward to slow the rotation down.
The free leg closes downward, its foot stepping onto the beam just in front of her.
She steps the free foot onto the beam and stands steady with arms extended wide.
(BB) flight salto: a video of an acrobatic salto on the balance beam: the gymnast leaves the beam, somersaults in the air, and lands back on the beam
The gymnast stands firmly on the beam, arms raised overhead, preparing to jump backward.
Her knees bend deeply as both arms swing down and behind her body.
Her body rises fully stretched, back arching as the backward rotation gets underway.

She spots the beam early and begins opening her body out of the tuck.

Both feet land together back on the beam, knees bending to absorb the twisting salto.

(BB) flight handspring: a video of a handspring or flic-flac element on the balance beam: the gymnast passes through a hand-support flight phase and lands back on the beam
The gymnast stands on the beam, arms overhead, preparing to jump backward as for a flic-flac.
She sits back with bent knees and swings her arms down past her hips.
Her back arches as both hands, or one supporting arm, reach for the beam.

Her hands, or a single supporting arm, meet the beam as she passes through handstand.
Her hips travel beyond her hands as the fast snap-down of the legs begins.
Her shoulders push off the beam as her chest begins to rise upward.
Her hands push off strongly, chest rising as both feet descend together.
The second foot lands in turn on the beam, completing the walkover forward.
She stands upright on the beam, arms extended, ready to connect the next skill.
(BB) dismount: a video of a balance beam dismount: the gymnast tumbles along the beam and saltos off to land on the mat
The gymnast accelerates along the beam, punching a round-off or flic-flac toward the beam’s end.

Rising high, she folds sharply at the hips with straight legs, taking a piked shape.

The second full twist spins around while the stretched backward salto continues turning.

Coming around, she releases the tuck and extends her legs down toward the mat.
Her body extends and drops toward the mat, falling clear of the beam.

(UB) circle: a video of a circle element on the uneven bars: the gymnast swings or circles around a bar, often finishing in a handstand
The gymnast casts out of front support on the bar, her hips rising toward handstand.
She folds into a deep pike, setting the soles of her feet on the bar near her hands.
In the piked sole-circle position she begins rotating backward around the bar.
A quick tap of the legs beneath the bar accelerates her into the upswing.
Her straight body rises backward toward the top of the bar with arms extended.
Her shoulders stay open as the hips rise toward the top of the circle.
Her free hand swings around the body and regrasps the bar as the turn ends.
Her body finishes rising into handstand in the new grip and new facing.
She completes the giant circle forward, returning to a fully stretched handstand.

The gymnast swings backward around the high bar in a fast giant swing.
Her legs snap in a strong tap under the bar, accelerating the upswing.
She releases the bar with both hands as the swing reaches its height.
She rotates forward at once, folding into a pike with legs pressed together.
During the salto she turns a half twist, rotating around to face the bar.
At the peak she sails clear above the rail in the open straddle position.
Keeping her chest toward the bar, she reaches down for it with both hands.
Her eyes lock onto the bar as the forward rotation comes fully around.
Both hands regrasp the high bar and her body settles into a hang.
She swings down beneath the bar in hang, flowing into the next element.
(UB) transition flight: a video of a transition flight element on the uneven bars: the gymnast flies between the low bar and the high bar
The gymnast swings on the high bar, shaping her momentum toward the low bar.
She drives her hips upward and back, shooting her body toward the high bar.
Her body flies free through the gap, traveling toward the low bar.
She stretches up across the gap, body extending between the two bars.
Her body rotates in the air, aligning her hands with the low rail.
The flight peaks as her hands arrive at the height of the high bar.
Both arms reach out ahead as the low bar comes within range.
Her body swings down beneath the high bar, legs together and extended.
Her body swings beneath the low bar, legs together and fully extended.
She rises on the far side of the swing, continuing on the high bar.
(UB) dismount: a video of an uneven bars dismount: the gymnast releases the bar, saltos in the air, and lands on the mat
The gymnast whips giant swings around the high bar, gathering speed for the dismount.
On the backward upswing her body rises, toes driving up behind the bar.

Her knees pull into a tight tuck as the double backward rotation begins.
The first forward salto turns quickly with her head tucked in tight.
She holds the tight layout line all the way through the second backward salto.
Still tucked, she rotates all the way through the second backward salto.
Her legs extend downward as she spots the landing mat waiting below.
